tools.name: businesses_search
tools.title: Search local businesses from Google Business Profiles
tools.description: Search local businesses from Google Business Profiles. 23M+ businesses with ratings, reviews, website contacts, socials and ad pixels. 30 per page. Charges 1 credit per business with an email or phone and 0.5 per business without. saveToContacts also stores them in your contacts.

location.description: A city ("Austin, TX"), a US state ("Texas") or a country ("Germany")

page.description: Page number, starting at 1; up to 30 businesses per page

keyword.description: Matched against the business name and categories

require.description: e.g. { "email": true, "metaAds": false }; false matches only businesses checked and found without it

saveToContacts.description: Save returned businesses to your Deeplead contacts

tools.name: organizations_search
tools.title: Search organizations, or look them up by domain
tools.description: Search organizations, or look them up by domain. Charges 0.5 credits per returned organization. limit 0 returns only totalCount, free.

query.description: Free text matched against company name, description and keywords

semantic.description: What the company is and sells, matched by meaning, e.g. "outsourced medical billing for clinics"

domains.description: Look companies up by domain, e.g. ["stripe.com"]

hqCountry.description: ISO alpha-2 country codes of the headquarters, e.g. ["US", "DE"]

hqState.description: US state names or codes of the headquarters

monthlyVisitsMin.description: Minimum monthly website visits; known for about 1 in 8 US companies, the rest are excluded

employeeGrowthMin.description: Minimum employee growth on LinkedIn in percent, e.g. 10; known for about 1 in 13 US companies

fundedAfter.description: Year of the last funding round, at least; known for about 1 in 100 US companies

hqCity.description: City names of the headquarters, e.g. ["Austin"]

limit.description: Maximum companies to return; 0 returns only a free count

offset.description: Number of matching companies to skip for pagination

includeWithoutWebsite.description: Include companies without websites in search results

monthlyGoogleAdSpend.description: Estimated monthly Google Ads spend in USD

employeeGrowthRate.description: Employee growth on LinkedIn in percent

type.description: e.g. Seed Round, Series A, Private Equity Round

adPixels.description: true/false where the website was checked, null where it never was

monthlyGoogleAdSpend.description: Estimated monthly Google Ads spend in USD

employeeGrowthRate.description: Employee growth on LinkedIn in percent

type.description: e.g. Seed Round, Series A, Private Equity Round

adPixels.description: true/false where the website was checked, null where it never was

tools.name: persons_search
tools.title: Search persons with their emails and phones
tools.description: Search persons with their emails and phones. Covers professional contacts only: people in their role at a company, not private individuals. Returns only people with an email or phone, with full contact data, and charges 1 credit per returned person. Page with nextOffset. limit 0 returns only totalCount, free. saveToContacts also stores them in your contacts, where people you already had are refunded.

query.description: Free text matched against company name, description and keywords

semantic.description: What the company is and sells, matched by meaning, e.g. "outsourced medical billing for clinics"

domains.description: Look companies up by domain, e.g. ["stripe.com"]

hqCountry.description: ISO alpha-2 country codes of the headquarters, e.g. ["US", "DE"]

hqState.description: US state names or codes of the headquarters

decisionMakersOnly.description: C-level, VP or director seniority, or a founder, owner, CEO, managing director or president title

inCountry.description: ISO alpha-2 country codes where the person is based

personState.description: States where the person is based

personCity.description: Cities where the person is based

offset.description: Pagination offset; use nextOffset from the previous response

onePerOrganization.description: Return at most one person per company

saveToContacts.description: Save returned people to your Deeplead contacts

totalCount.description: With limit 0: all matching people, including those without an email or phone

tools.name: deliverability_create_test
tools.title: Start an inbox placement test for a mailbox you send from
tools.description: Start an inbox placement test for a mailbox you send from. Send one email from the mailbox you want to test to every address in seedEmails, with the testId anywhere in the body, then poll deliverability_get_test about once a minute to see whether it landed in the inbox, spam or a tab at Gmail, Outlook and other providers. Most seeds report within 2-5 minutes; the test closes 60 minutes after it starts. Charges 25 credits.

testId.description: Put this anywhere in the body of the test email

seedEmails.description: Send the test email to every one of these addresses

tools.name: deliverability_get_test
tools.title: Where the test email landed at each seed mailbox
tools.description: Where the test email landed at each seed mailbox. Poll about once a minute while status is waiting. placement is inbox, spam, promotions, social, updates or forums, or missing while the email has not arrived; score is the inbox share from 0 to 10 once the test is completed. rspamd is the content filter verdict with its matched rules, when a seed reports one.
